tests.title: the catalog: every kind has blocks, every block has a definition and a parameter shape the engine reads, ports follow the kind
trigger units_used: the authorizations at the warning share; the rule-bound number is the rule (a stored 99 does not win), and editing the rule moves the line
trigger payer_reply: one stage group each (info, partial, denied, p2p, overdue); an empty choice starts nothing
trigger deadline_near: within N days or past it; the kind of deadline narrows it (renewal, decision, appeal)
trigger followup_day: a submitted request on or past the follow-up day (the rule), judged on the day given
trigger note_late: notes behind (daily, weekly guardian, monthly collateral), filtered by type, labelled by initials
trigger eligibility_due: a check older than the interval (the rule) is a candidate; a patient with no recorded check is not
conditions route a record down Yes or No: payer is, service is, units left, partial award, owner is, evidence has gaps
condition evidence_missing: Yes for a patient whose stored evidence has gaps, No for one without (a one-day window and a note on file)
tests.note: T.N. has a note for the one day in the window expected ["TN"] but got ["MR","TN"]

tests.title: actions: notify, add a task and suggest a flag each give one effect with its roles; messages fill only {patient}, {payer}, {date}
branching: a fan-out reaches every branch once; a chain passes through guardrails; a record that falls off the map is counted, not matched
guardrail roles_only: only those roles receive what follows; no role left stops the path and says why
guardrail person_confirms: the item waits for the named roles ("needs your confirmation"); other roles are not asked
guardrail max_per_day: at most n items per role; the most urgent stay, the rest are counted as limited and not shown
guardrail source_required: stops a path whose rule is an unverified demo assumption (and says which); lets a Harvest-reported or verified one through
guardrail evidence_required: stops a record with evidence gaps and keeps the one without
two_person and the locked never_auto have no effect at run time: the locked guardrail takes no links and is never walked
validate: a good workflow is ok; errors for no trigger, an unknown block, a link to a missing block, a port the block lacks, a link into a trigger or the locked block
validate: a cycle, a block no trigger reaches (the locked guardrail needs no link), a rule key that is not in the rules table
validate: a parameter out of range or of the wrong type (number, whole number, select, multi, roles, payers, text, bool)
validate warns (does not refuse): nothing after a trigger, a Yes or No exit that leads nowhere
tidy: x and y are multiples of the grid, triggers sit at the left, Yes is above No, the locked guardrail is bottom right, the input is untouched and it is idempotent
tidy: two triggers stack, a block nobody links to is placed (not lost), a cycle does not hang it
normalize and ensureLocked: positions snap to the grid, settings come from the catalog, one locked guardrail is always present, duplicate links go
newId: n-xxxx, unique among the ids taken
run and workflowItems are deterministic and never write: a deep-frozen state and workflow give the same answer twice
the same answer from the clinician, supervisor and administrator projections (the engine reads status, never note text)
workflowItems: enabled workflows only, items for the role named, ids "wf:<workflow>:<record>:<node>", group Workflows, a source and a link the role may open
workflowItems for direct support: only their own patients, linked to the patient chart
notificationsFor appends the workflow items (unread, group Workflows) without changing the others; read state works on their ids
seed: five workflows (two on, three off), each valid and laid out on the grid with the locked guardrail; the same graphs as the templates
seed behaviour on the Oct 29 canvas: the partial offer gives the clinician a task (to confirm) and the supervisor a notice; follow-up day gives nothing yet; templates run when turned on
